name: Emporiqa
description: Integrates Drupal Commerce with the Emporiqa chat assistant.

suggests.drupal/commerce_stock: Enables real-time stock level tracking for product availability.
suggests.drush/drush: Provides CLI commands for manual sync operations.

project_description: Emporiqa connects a Drupal Commerce storefront to the Emporiqa SaaS chat assistant. The Drupal module handles the site side of the integration: it syncs Commerce products, variations, and opted-in content nodes to the Emporiqa platform over signed webhooks (per-entity queue on cron, plus admin Batch UI and Drush full-sync commands), embeds the chat widget script on non-admin pages, and exposes small JSON cart endpoints so the widget can view and modify the visitor's session cart. It also issues an HMAC-signed user-identity token, sends an order.completed webhook on configured Commerce order transitions, and answers order-tracking lookups from the platform through an HMAC-verified endpoint. Product/page payloads carry all enabled translations and per-store channels, with resolved promotion-aware prices and stock read from Commerce Stock, a configured field, or publish status. A rich set of alter hooks lets other modules reshape payloads, channels, prices, order tracking, and cart operations.
